seo.title: About My Sweet Home | Gift and Home Goods Shop
seo.description: My Sweet Home is a gift and home goods shop for body care sets, floral drinkware, embroidered cushions and ceramic cups in gift boxes.

sections.heading: A little shop full of sweet things
sections.subheading: The story behind My Sweet Home
body: My Sweet Home is a gift and home goods shop for pretty things that make a day feel softer. On our shelves you will find body care sets with lotion, hand cream and fragrance mist, wildflower-print water bottles, and floral insulated tumblers with bow straw toppers.
For the home, there are embroidered cushion covers, and ceramic cups and saucers that arrive in their own gift boxes, ready to be given.
Everything here is chosen with the same idea in mind: a gift should look lovely and feel personal, and your home should feel like yours.
NEEDS: the owner's name, a short account of how My Sweet Home began and why, and a portrait photo of the owner with the products.
